staleness_note: This file deliberately carries no timestamp: a clock here would make every sync commit a file whose only change is the time. Read `generated_at` from `.colaberry/manifest.json` and label it "last changed", not "last checked".

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The workflow's own comment states these are live brand styles and that the pull request IS the review. An agent that could merge it would delete the control the workflow was built to create, so the ceiling sits at multi-step sandbox analysis with a written recommendation and no merge authority.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Performance work trades against features and visual richness, so the trade is a human call. Without an agreed budget there is no reference outcome to shadow against, which keeps this below autonomy:R5 until a budget exists.

A measured ratio is an objective fact with a reference answer, so shadow mode against human-confirmed results is reachable. It stays below automation because the fix for a contrast failure is a colour change, and a colour change is a brand decision.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Whether two similar components should become one is an architecture judgement with a real blast radius, and the contract routes larger refactors to escalation. The agent detects and proposes only.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Changing a chart changes what a customer reads from their data, which is a product and brand decision. The agent audits and proposes; it stays below shadow mode because no approved reference set of correct product charts exists yet.

Detection and reporting have no customer-visible effect, so shadow mode against a human-reviewed reference inventory (autonomy:R5) is the honest ceiling. It stops below autonomy:R6/autonomy:R7 because the remediation this audit proposes repaints the product, and repainting the product is a brand decision a human makes.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: What an empty or failed state should say is design and copy work, so a human decides it. The agent inventories the gaps and stays below shadow mode because no approved reference set of correct states exists.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: How honest the product looks is a brand and trust decision. The agent finds unlabelled figures and indistinguishable modes; a human decides the label and the visual treatment.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Writing alt text is authoring customer-facing copy, so it is a human decision. The agent can find gaps and draft candidates but stays below shadow mode because there is no approved reference set of correct alt text to shadow against.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Detection is objective and shadow-comparable. Remediation converts markup and can move layout, so the agent proposes and a human ships.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: This capability exists to carry a human's decision, so the agent's share of it is presenting evidence and recording an answer. It cannot rise above answering from approved knowledge without becoming the decision-maker it was built to serve.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Motion is a felt, expressive property of the brand, and the right answer is often a judgement rather than a threshold. The agent reports and proposes; a designer decides. No approved reference motion set exists to shadow against, so it stays below autonomy:R5.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Whether two brands should look alike is a positioning decision, not a lint result. The agent can only compare and report; the intent against which divergence is judged comes from a human, so it stays below shadow mode until that reference exists.

The checks are objective, already written, and comparable against a known-good run, so shadow mode fits. It stays below automation because every remedy is a code or layout change that a human reviews.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Interface copy is what the customer reads, so a human approves every word. The agent detects and drafts, and stays below shadow mode because no approved reference copy set exists to shadow against.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Published copy is customer-facing and carries regulatory exposure, so a human decides every wording change. The agent stays at multi-step sandbox analysis; it does not even reach shadow mode for rule authorship, because no approved reference set of correct copy exists to shadow against.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Overflow and box size are measurable facts, shadow-comparable against an accepted baseline. Remediation changes layout, which is what the customer sees, so a human ships it.

An inventory is a read-only derived fact, shadow-comparable against a human-checked list. No customer-visible change follows directly from it, but it stops below automation because its consumers are the audits that do propose changes.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The packet exists so a human can make the visual judgement, so the capability is complete at preparing it. Automating the judgement would defeat the purpose of the artefact, which keeps this below autonomy:R5.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Restructuring the styling layer is an architecture change with a product-wide blast radius, which the repository contract routes to escalation. The agent's ceiling is mapping and proposing from approved knowledge.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: This is an assessment that informs a product decision, not a change. Its ceiling is answering the readiness question from measured evidence; the decision it informs is not the agent's to make.

Reachability is a computed fact with a checkable reference answer, so shadow mode is appropriate. It stops below automation because acting on a finding means deleting or routing a page, which changes the product.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: The standard is the manager's own statement of what good looks like. The agent may draft it and apply it, never ratify it, so it cannot rise above answering from approved knowledge.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: A gate whose own autonomy could rise would stop being a gate. The agent prepares the evidence and records the outcome, and never holds the approving authority, at any rung.

reasons: human_decision_required_at_every_level
authority.ceiling_reason: Auditing is safe and shadow-mode comparable against a human-reviewed reference audit, so autonomy:R5. It stops below automation because almost every remediation alters rendered markup or visible styling, and what the customer sees is a human decision.

authority_rule.rule: A capability approved above autonomy:R2 with no granted tools is forced back down to autonomy:R2, with the reason no_tool_grants. Tool grants are the throttle.
authority_rule.note: When this binds nothing, say so in words. It means no capability in this domain has been approved above autonomy:R2 yet, not that the rule is absent or that the panel failed.

governance.disclosure: A filed request grants nothing. Status is what a named human decided, and a pending row means nobody has decided yet.

verification.disclosure: A criterion counts as passing when it is marked in `.colaberry/progress.json` in this repository. The verifier reads that file on every sync and records what it found. A story showing 0 of N is not a rejection: nothing has been claimed yet.
